subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配体分类：下列配体属于哪一种 L/X 类型：pentamethylcyclopentadienyl (η⁵)（Cp*）？
A. L₂X
B. L₂X₂
C. X₃
D. LX
explanation: Cp* (pentamethylcyclopentadienyl (η⁵)) is an L₂X ligand: each L gives 2 electrons and each X one, so 5 electrons in the covalent count (6 in the ionic count).
